requiredHostFunctions: el(tag, optionalText, optionalClass): safe element with textContent

rules: Embed a reviewed JSON value, not executable provider text.
Keep term and source IDs unique and all sourceRefs resolvable.
Merge the help supplement only with the corresponding reviewed base registry.
Search variants retain their kind, authority and language; no exactMatch is inferred.
The source-only helpStatus must remain visible.
Render example.text only when example.kind is 'authored-synthetic-example', as text under an illustrative-example heading. It is an authored example, not native evidence.

lifecycle: Load the host model and construct required DOM first.
Call initialiseExperience once after the host is ready.
Use experienceShow(taskId, focus) for cross-task actions.
Use experienceFeatureView('earlier'|'added') for the native-observation subview.
The overlay reserves #task/{taskId} fragments and in-memory practice state.
Task routing ignores unrelated fragments such as skip-link targets; an empty fragment restores the learning task. A supplied reference skip link unfolds the inspector first.
scopeLimits: No model, map renderer, server, API client or provider dataset is supplied by this overlay.
Host contents, captions and provenance remain the host's responsibility.
The stylesheet layers over the reviewed host structure; it is not a generic design system.
Synthetic tests do not establish browser reflow, assistive-technology acceptance or human learning outcomes.
